observations.quote: Concerns intensified after the Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia is in talks to provide $250 billion in financing to OpenAI as part of a data center project in Ohio.
observations.one_line: 据《华尔街日报》报道，英伟达正就为OpenAI俄亥俄州数据中心项目提供2500亿美元融资进行洽谈；安排尚处于洽谈阶段。
observations.speaker: CTech记者转述《华尔街日报》报道

observations.quote: According to Jefferies, investors view the proposed arrangement as a prominent example of "circular financing," in which financing provided by a supplier ultimately helps generate demand for its own products.
observations.one_line: Jefferies称，投资者将英伟达拟向OpenAI提供融资的安排视为“循环融资”的突出案例：供应商提供的资金最终帮助产生对其自身产品的需求。
observations.speaker: CTech记者转述Jefferies

observations.quote: Nvidia, meanwhile, fell 5%, reducing its market value to $4.78 trillion, after Bloomberg reported that the cost of insuring the chipmaker's debt against default had risen by a record amount amid concerns over its growing commitments to AI infrastructure investments.
observations.one_line: 2026-07-27，英伟达股价下跌5%、市值降至4.78万亿美元；报道将其与彭博所述公司债务违约保险成本创纪录上升及市场对其AI基础设施投资承诺增加的担忧联系起来。
observations.speaker: CTech记者转述Bloomberg报道

observations.quote: After driving the market higher for more than two years, AI-related stocks are facing increased scrutiny as investors question whether the enormous spending on AI infrastructure will ultimately generate adequate returns.
observations.one_line: 截至2026-07-28，媒体称AI相关股票正受到更多审视，投资者质疑巨额AI基础设施支出最终能否产生足够回报。
observations.speaker: CTech记者

observations.quote: Nvidia also came under pressure after the IPO of Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT triggered a sharp selloff across the semiconductor sector. Investors fear a new Chinese competitor could erode the pricing power of the industry's three dominant memory manufacturers, Micron, Samsung and SK Hynix.
observations.one_line: 报道指出，CXMT上市后半导体板块大幅抛售；投资者担心中国新竞争者会削弱Micron、Samsung和SK Hynix的定价权，并使英伟达承压。
observations.speaker: CTech记者
